title: Railway – The all-in-one intelligent cloud provider
description: Bold, modern deployment platform with a distinctive navy/orange color scheme. Hero uses oversized gradient typography with a spinning 3D cube animation. Feature sections use staggered card layouts with icons and animated hover states. Dark top nav with gradient CTA. Stats counters, customer logo bar, and a clean pricing section. The live site uses a hero_3d, features_staggered, stats, customer_logos, pricing, cta structure with strong visual hierarchy and smooth scroll-triggered animations throughout. Navigation is clean and unobtrusive. The color palette and typography work together to create a cohesive brand experience that aligns with the product category.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for railway-style products.
style_vibe: Bold, modern deployment platform with a distinctive navy/orange color scheme.
